hero.title: تصميم يستحق النقرة الثانية
hero.subtitle: تصميم يستحق النقرة الثانية. واجهات مصممة حول كيفية استخدام الشيء فعلاً، لا حول ما يبدو جميلاً في لوحة مزاج.

subServices.name: بحث المستخدمين
subServices.longDesc: نبدأ بالحديث مع مستخدمين حقيقيين. المخرج ليس ملصق شخصية — قائمة أولويات واضحة لما يجب أن يفعله التصميم جيداً.

subServices.name: هياكل الصفحات
subServices.longDesc: قبل البكسل نرسم الهيكل. أرخص مكان لتصحيح أغلى الأخطاء — فلا نتخطاه.

subServices.name: التصميم البصري
subServices.longDesc: ملفات فِغما عالية الدقة، ونظام خط ولون وحركة. المكتبة تبقى لفريقك بعد انتهاء العمل معنا.

subServices.name: النماذج التفاعلية
subServices.longDesc: نماذج لأصحاب المصلحة واختبار المستخدمين. نختبر أخطر الافتراضات قبل أن تُصرف هندسة.

process.title: Discover
process.desc: Research, analytics review, and a 1-page problem statement

process.title: Define
process.desc: Jobs to be done, success metrics, and the v1 scope

process.title: Design
process.desc: Wireframes, then visual design in Figma, with weekly reviews

process.title: Validate
process.desc: User testing on prototypes, iterate, and lock the system

process.title: Handoff
process.desc: Annotated Figma, a Storybook-ready component library, and a working session with your devs

deliverables.title: Figma source of truth
deliverables.description: A clean, organized Figma file with components, variables, and ready-to-handoff frames.

deliverables.title: Design system
deliverables.description: Type, color, spacing, motion, and iconography — documented and ready to scale.

deliverables.title: Prototype
deliverables.description: Clickable prototype in Figma or code, for stakeholder review and user testing.

deliverables.title: Handoff package
deliverables.description: Specs, redlines, assets, and a working session with your engineering team.

faq.question: Do you also build the design in code?
faq.answer: Yes. Most of our engagements end with a working front end. We can ship Astro, Next.js, SvelteKit, or React Native — whatever your stack prefers. The handoff is smooth because we are the same team doing both.

faq.question: Can you take over an existing design system?
faq.answer: Frequently. We start with a design system audit, propose a path to clean it up, and ship it in a Storybook that your engineers actually use. We have rescued Figma files with 2,000+ components and turned them into something maintainable.

faq.question: How do you handle accessibility?
faq.answer: Accessibility is not a checklist we run at the end. We design for keyboard, screen readers, and color contrast from the first wireframe, and we test with real assistive tech before handoff. WCAG AA is our default; AAA where it matters.

faq.question: What if I only have a brand, not a product idea?
faq.answer: That is a great place to start. We run a 2-week discovery sprint that ends in a product brief, a feature list, and a prototype you can use to raise, recruit, or sell. From there, we can design and build the first version.
